purpose: Describe following a guide or a change that develops alongside another.
keywords: Noun / verb dictionary form + に従って
Please move as directed by the staff.
The temperature fell as we climbed the mountain.
We proceeded with the work according to the plan.
formation: Noun / verb dictionary form + に従って
restrictions: With instructions it means follow; with changing events it means as.
mistake: For an instruction use a noun such as 指示; a verb clause usually describes linked change.
